title: Length, distance & diagonals
sentences: At constant speed, distance is speed multiplied by time in matching units.
On a coordinate plane, horizontal and vertical changes become the legs of a right triangle.
A rectangle's diagonal uses the same relationship.
A route with turns can be longer than the straight line between its endpoints.
The points are 5 coordinate units apart.
